scenes.narration: Self-hosted runners do one job at a time. Jobs queue up, and whatever one job leaves behind, the next one inherits.

scenes.visual: Motion Canvas opening: solution (one job, one fresh VM, gone when done)
scenes.narration: kinhin fixes that. Every job gets its own fresh VM or container, deleted when the job is done.

scenes.visual: MacBook shot of the demo fleet (frame-app.sh); cue times are seconds into the shot

cues.text: Jobs arrive, and kinhin scales to the queue, within your Mac's limits.
Each job gets its own clean instance.
macOS VMs and Linux containers, side by side.
When one fails, the next still starts clean.
Every instance is deleted. Nothing lingers.

scenes.visual: Terminal clip (terminal/install.tape); cue times are seconds into the clip

cues.text: Then kinhin doctor checks your Mac.

scenes.narration: It works with GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo, on Tart, apple container or Docker.

cues.text: One job. One VM. Gone when it's done.
kinhin.dev. Free, open source, no telemetry.
cues.say: kinhin dot dev. Free, open source, no telemetry.
